**Verdict: FAIL.** The candidate ID matches (sha256:4b84bf20…, 2732 files) in the repository and in a clone of 654e39d89. My three open findings are fixed, but checking F-DG6-220 from other angles turned up a new access-control leak (High, mandatory).

**Open findings: all CLOSED_VERIFIED**
- **F-DG6-220 (High):** my round-3 probe and BE-Z4's test pass 7/7. TL and AUD no longer see the case, decision or link in lists, and get 404 on each item. Reverting BE-Z4 makes 5 tests fail.
- **F-DG6-221 (Low):** on the Arabic exception page, "Last error" now shows Arabic text, in en and ar on the real stack. Reverting the fix makes 5 unit tests fail.
- **F-DG6-222 (Medium):** exactly one field (the credential row) is marked, with the reason in the page language and no server English. FE-Z2's e2e passes 4/4, and reverting the fix makes 4 unit tests fail.

**New findings**
- **F-DG6-280 (High, mandatory, REQ-S10-002 / M0188):** a sensitive benefit's title still reaches people who get 404 on the benefit.
  - The worker titles a benefit-variance case with the benefit's title. When that case is recorded as a red blocker in two meetings, the escalation job copies the title into executive ask DEC-01.
  - TL, AUD and SP then read "Synthetic churn reduction" in the executive-decision list and item, and SP gets it in an inbox notification.
  - TL, who gets 404 on the case, could still record it as a blocker (201). TL can get the case's id from the action register.
  - I also expect search to find the ask by its title (the search indexer covers decision titles). I read this in the code but did not run the indexer.
- **F-DG6-281 (Low, REQ-S17-001):** the connector edit screen's "Target transformation" shows "Choose…" when the stored target is a transformation dev.admin cannot see. Saving keeps the right value, so this is display only.

**The two open questions from D-211**
- Action rows, meeting actions and controls showing a restricted case's id or code, with no values: acceptable under ADR-0051. It is that visible id, though, that lets TL trigger F-DG6-280.
- The "Choose…" target select: raised as F-DG6-281.

**Decisions:** I accept D-194 to D-196, D-199 item 2, D-202 and D-203 to D-205. The automation, load and export code has not changed since round 3.

**Test runs, all on this candidate**

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| Validators (`--register DG6`, `--historical` DG5–DG1) | all PASS |
| Build | exit 0 |
| QA integration | 45/45 files |
| Implementer P6 integration | 44/44 files, 563 tests |
| Root P6 e2e | 36/36 |
| A20 specs | 226 passed, 18 declared axe skips (same as the orchestrator) |
| Demo stack | 12/12 |
| Unit, Node 24 | 4938/4938 |
| Unit, Node 22.22.0 (the installed version; the assignment names 22.22.2) | 4938/4938 |

**Failures in the logs, all explained in the record**
- **Disk full:** the shared scratch disk hit 100% while the three reviews ran together. The first QA run lost 9 files to "No space left on device", my English screen probe failed the same way, and the first implementer run stopped mid-log. Each was re-run alone and passed.
- **Escalation probe:** it exits 1 on purpose; its two failing assertions are the F-DG6-280 leak.
- **Unit-test console errors:** the stderr lines come from one header test that stubs page data. That test passes.

The assignment's record format says `round: 3`; I recorded `round: 4` to match the round-4 path.

I deleted the disposable clone. The rest of the scratch folder could not be removed, because the safety check blocked an `rm` over a `$TMPDIR` glob. It is small and the runner clears it when the run ends.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-4/`:
- domain-reviewer.json
- domain-reviewer.findings.json
- domain-reviewer.verifications.json

Evidence, with EN and AR screenshots, is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/domain/round-4/`.
